releaseNotes: Platform fix: the built-in deliverable drafts — what an instance with no drafting service configured produces, and the first document many founders read here — had three sections that came out blank and one line that came out as ". The current working price is ." whenever the fields they interpolate were empty. Every one of those fields is one a founder is allowed to clear, and the seeded demo company has all of them filled, so the existing tests only ever exercised the single input shape where the code was correct. Where a value is missing the document now says so plainly, which is also what the founder needs to read.

The fixtures are the durable part. Every deliverable type is now built three ways — from a complete company, from one with every optional field cleared, and from a workstream that has recorded no facts, assumptions, or questions — and each result is held to the same bar: no empty section, no sentence with a hole in it, and nothing Formation would refuse if a founder submitted the same document as an edit. A company object missing a field outright, which the API cannot produce but a restored store can, no longer takes the drafting worker down. The detector that finds the holes is itself tested against known-bad and known-good prose, so it cannot be loosened into agreement. Checks, 164 domain tests, the production build, and the full audit pass.
